protocol.purpose: Control replication repairing RNG stream coupling; not a new preregistration

split.method: per-class shuffled indices; floor(0.2*n_class), remaining test slots by largest fractional remainder, ties class 0 first; shuffle both splits
split.rng: independent default_rng(seed) for generation, splitting, initialization

encoding.order: Qiskit little endian |q1 q0>; input feature j maps to qubit j

base_protocol.simulation: exact complex128 statevector, no noise, no shots

training.loss: mean binary cross entropy; p clipped to [1e-12,1-1e-12]
training.gradient: parameter shift of probability, chain rule through BCE; clip derivative zero outside clipping interval
training.selection: parameters after exactly 100 updates; history includes initial loss and loss after each update

metrics.resources: encoding+ansatz transpiled to ry,rz,h,cx; optimization_level=0; seed_transpiler=0; input [0.3,0.7], theta zero
metrics.timing: perf_counter training including encoding preparation, full optimization and histories; excludes evaluation, plotting, imports; RY then ZZ, serial; descriptive only

protocol.only_intervention: Replace repeated same-seed RNG instances by three spawned role streams

rng.pairing: same dataset, split and copied initialization for RY and ZZ

protocol.interpretation: New data, splits and initialization realizations; not an isolated initialization ablation. Across-study changes are descriptive, not paired causal effects.
